It keeps your photos and videos in OneDrive and manages how much space they take on your phone. It is not a gallery — your phone’s own gallery keeps doing the viewing, and everything stays there as an ordinary file.
You choose the folders. Anything outside them is not scanned, not listed, and never touched — so an album you did not pick cannot be given a mode by accident.

Off leaves an album alone. Backup copies it to OneDrive and changes nothing on your phone. Sync copies it and then shrinks the photos to save space, leaving them visible in your gallery. Video is left whole.
I understand — Sync makes my photos smaller on this phone

Archive takes an album off your phone once every file in it is confirmed in OneDrive. It is a standing instruction: anything you add to that album later is covered by the same choice.
The files go to your phone’s Trash/Recycle Bin, where you can put them back. The space they used does not come back until you empty that bin yourself — this app never empties it for you.
I understand — Archive takes these files off my phone

Before anything is removed or shrunk, OneDrive has to confirm it holds the file and report the same size as the copy on your phone. That check is the guarantee, and nothing skips it.
Local removals go to your phone’s Trash/Recycle Bin and can be restored for 30 days. We have seen that hold on the phones we tested, but we cannot promise it for every phone — the verified cloud copy is the part that always holds.

No backup is safe because an app says so, and that includes this one. Software has bugs, cloud accounts expire, and a file can arrive damaged in ways a size check does not catch.
Open OneDrive now and then and look at your photos there. Not the list — open a few and check they actually appear. Do it before you empty a recycle bin, because that is the point where the second copy stops existing.
For anything you could not bear to lose, keep a copy somewhere this app cannot reach.
I understand — I will check my own backups

The Restore tab lists what this app has shrunk on this phone and puts the full-size original back in place, in its own folder, under its own name. Stopping partway costs nothing and you can run it again.

A photo or video is replaced by a smaller version while the full-quality original stays in OneDrive. It keeps working everywhere on your phone and you can fetch the original back whenever you want. Only files older than the age you set are touched, so nothing you shot today is affected unless you ask for it.
I understand — optimised photos are smaller until I fetch the original

Nothing happens to the OneDrive copy unless you say so. The app will not read a missing file as an instruction to delete anything. You can change this later, and it will ask you at the point it first matters.
This app never empties a recycle bin — not your gallery’s and not OneDrive’s. Whatever gets removed stays recoverable until you empty it yourself, in those apps.

Backing up runs on its own in the background. Archiving and optimising only ever happen while this app is open, because Android requires a tap for them — so if you are waiting for space to be freed, open the app. Restoring only happens when you ask.

resources.string: Take a quick peek at the navigation and features.
GallerySync keeps your photos and videos backed up in Cloud Services and manages how much space they take on your phone. Here\'s what you\'ll find:
See your folders and choose what to back up
Browse and download files from Cloud Services
Review files verified in the cloud and free up space
Press any (?) for a quick explanation of that line. For everything in one place, open the How To Guide at the top of Settings.
There are four simple steps to get you started.
Choose your cloud storage and sign in to it
Give permission to search this phone for photos and videos
Choose which of the folders it finds you want backed up, and where each one goes
Give permission to change files in those folders
First, permission to search. GallerySync needs to find where your photos and videos are located on your device.
The search found these folders. Check the ones you want backed up. Press next to give GallerySync specific permission to use these folders.
